rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a supernatural miracle, an astonishingly lucky outcome, or an exceptional example such as an economic miracle.

example.english: Winning the match this time was a miracle; it was really unexpected.
example.traditional: 呢次奇跡咁贏到場波，真係估唔到。
